description: Pinned agent tooling for Claude Code sessions. Read and enforced by scripts/setup-agent.sh. Update versions here and rerun the script with FORCE=1.

tools.name: ui-ux-pro-max
tools.notes: The installer also writes banner-design, brand, design-system, design, slides and ui-styling skills (claudekit); they overlap other roles and are discarded.

tools.name: taste-skill
tools.role: art direction and openly licensed images with credits
tools.installer: git checkout of the pinned commit, copy of skills/taste-skill (skill name: design-taste-frontend)
tools.notes: Equivalent to `npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill design-taste-frontend`, but pinned to a commit and without the skills CLI telemetry.

tools.name: impeccable
tools.installer: git checkout of the pinned commit, copy of .claude/skills/impeccable (the compiled Claude Code project install)
tools.telemetry: off (npx impeccable@4.6.0 telemetry off; stored in ~/.impeccable/config.json)
tools.notes: Hooks and subagents that the project install ships (.claude/settings.json hooks, .claude/agents) are intentionally not kept: the hooks run on every edit and at every stop.

tools.name: seo-audit

tools.installer: git checkout of the pinned commit, copy of skills/seo-audit (skill name: seo-audit)
tools.notes: Text skill with references, no runtime. Same repository and commit as the other marketingskills entry. It mentions .agents/product-marketing.md, which does not exist here: the brief is the context.
